_comment: Employer job boards checked directly by tools/employer_boards.py on every /scrape. One entry per company Hassan has applied to or is actively tracking. 'board' selects the adapter; 'slug' is the board identifier for that ATS. Add a company here when the first application to it is submitted. 'include_locations' is a regex on the posting's location text; postings that fail it are ignored for the new-roles list (liveness checks ignore it). Datavant, Tempus, Function Health, and Hippocratic AI are NOT on Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever under any slug tried on 2026-09-12 (Datavant uses a Workday-style or custom career site); they are covered by the Priority 7/8 portal queries instead until an adapter exists. 'title_include' (optional) is a further regex on the title for big employers that post hundreds of Director/Clinical reqs.
